To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the interexaminer and intrarater reliability of ultrasound imaging for select foot muscles is excellent and bearing weight did not affect reliability.
the intrinsic foot muscles of young, asymptomatic individuals can be reliably imaged in the weight bearing state using diagnostic ultrasound.
diagnostic ultrasound imaging is reliable for select intrinsic foot and ankle muscles and that bearing weight does not reduce inter- or intraexaminer ultrasound imaging reliability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the reliability of weight bearing diagnostic ultrasound imaging of the intrinsic foot muscle.
the reliability of diagnostic imaging of select intrinsic foot muscles in the non weight bearing posture and in the weight bearing postures and the change in muscle size when bearing weight.
the reliability of diagnostic ultrasonography of the intrinsic foot musculature.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
diagnostic ultrasound is a reliable and valid method to measure the intrinsic muscles of the foot and bearing weight has no effect on reliability.
diagnostic ultrasound is a valid and reliable method to image the intrinsic foot muscles bearing weight.
ultrasound imaging is a reliable method for assessing select intrinsic foot muscles in the weight bearing position and that bearing weight increases muscle cross-sectional area.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
weight bearing diagnostic ultrasound imaging is a reliable method for imaging the foot muscles in young, asymptomatic participants.
ultrasound is a reliable method to image the intrinsic foot muscles, and that the muscles are larger when bearing weight.
diagnostic ultrasound of the foot and ankle is reliable and reproducible.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ultrasound imaging can be performed in the weight bearing position without compromising the reliability of the measurement.
diagnostic ultrasound imaging of the intrinsic foot musculature is reliable in both the non-weight-bearing and weight bearing posturing.
weight bearing ultrasound imaging of the intrinsic foot musculature is a feasible and reliable technique.
